description: This file contains utility functions for handling FX nodes, chunking metadata, and tangent nodes within the PyTorch FX graph framework, specifically related to the auto_chunker component in the torch._inductor module.

methods.name: is_tangent_node
methods.description: Checks if a node is a tangent node based on its operation and name.

methods.name: get_args_of_node_type
methods.description: Retrieves the arguments of a node that are FX nodes.

methods.name: use_tangent
methods.description: Determines if an FX node uses tangent input.

methods.name: compute_tensor_size
methods.description: Calculates total size in bytes of tensors represented by FX nodes.

methods.name: get_fake_tensor_from_node_arg
methods.description: Extracts a fake tensor from a node argument if available.

methods.name: get_nodes_with_chunking_meta
methods.description: Finds nodes in a graph that have associated chunking metadata.

methods.name: format_node_with_chunking_meta
methods.description: Prints node info along with chunking metadata, optionally including arguments.

methods.name: has_any_chunking_meta
methods.description: Checks if any nodes in a list have chunking metadata.

methods.name: get_first_chunking_meta
methods.description: Returns the first available chunking metadata from a list of nodes.

methods.name: get_scale_by_from_metas
methods.description: Retrieves the scale_by node from multiple chunking metas, raises if multiple are found.

methods.name: get_scale_by_from_node
methods.description: Gets the scale_by node from a specific FX node's chunking meta.

methods.name: get_node_is_scalar
methods.description: Returns a dict mapping nodes to whether they are scalar tensors.

methods.name: get_node_ndim
methods.description: Returns a dict mapping nodes to their tensor dimensions.

methods.name: is_chunked_by_dim
methods.description: Checks if a node is chunked along a specific dimension.

methods.name: tangent_has_chunking_meta
methods.description: Checks if tangent nodes in a graph module have chunking metadata.

methods.name: get_tangent_nodes
methods.description: Retrieves all tangent nodes from a graph.
